module.summary: Compatibility shim (added by this project): stock Spring/Recoil has no Zero-K LuaRules/Utilities layer, so this file fills in the missing Spring.Utilities.CopyTable, Spring.ScaledGetMouseState, Spring.GetViewSizes and Spring.Orig at the very start of the framework load; existing functions of the same name are never overwritten, so the directory also stays ZK-compatible.

fileDesc: Added compatibility layer: supplies Spring.Utilities.CopyTable / Spring.ScaledGetMouseState / Spring.GetViewSizes / Spring.Orig for non-ZK engines so chili loads in any Recoil game.
